<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import os

# Paths
input_file = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
output_clusters = "outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv"
output_profiles = "outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv"

# Load input data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Identify numeric columns for clustering (DE1001V is the only numeric indicator column)
numeric_cols = ['DE1001V']

# Handle missing values with median imputation on numeric columns
numeric_df = df[numeric_cols].copy()
median_values = numeric_df.median()
numeric_df = numeric_df.fillna(median_values)

# Standard scaling (z-score normalization)
numeric_scaled = (numeric_df - numeric_df.mean()) / numeric_df.std()

# Prepare data for KMeans
X_scaled = numeric_scaled.values

# Apply KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
kmeans.fit(X_scaled)

# Get cluster assignments
cluster_labels = kmeans.labels_

# Create output DataFrame with cluster assignments
output_clusters_df = df.copy()
output_clusters_df['cluster_id'] = cluster_labels

# Save city clusters CSV
output_clusters_df.to_csv(output_clusters, index=False, quoting=pandas.CQUOTE)

# Create cluster profiles - mean of RAW indicator values (not scaled, not imputed)
# Only compute for non-missing values
cluster_profiles = []
for cluster_id in range(3):
    cluster_mask = df['cluster_id'] == cluster_id
    cluster_data = df.loc[cluster_mask, numeric_cols]
    
    # Compute mean of raw values (before median imputation and standard scaling)
    means = cluster_data.mean()
    cluster_profiles.append({
        'cluster_id': cluster_id,
        'mean': means.to_dict()
    })

# Save cluster profiles CSV
profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(cluster_profiles)
profiles_df.to_csv(output_profiles, index=False, quoting=pandas.CQUOTE)

print("Clustering complete. Output files created.")
</solution_file>
